parent_objective: design bounded reset validation for M2350 candidate config packs
blocked_by: M2351 routes to reset-validation design but does not run reset validation
M2350 candidate packs are artifact files and need reset-validity evidence before any rollout or controller comparison
supersedes: direct measured validation over M2350 packs
direct patch-resolution repair before reset-validation design

public_gates: M2352 must design reset validation over the five M2350 config packs
M2352 must define metadata-only caveat reporting and fail-closed reset criteria
M2352 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim residual support solved
do not claim controller comparison readiness
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim reset-valid redesigned scenario pack

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs bounded reset-validation protocol for five candidate config packs
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no reset execution, measured rollout, ranking, paper, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design runs reset validation
stop if design ignores metadata-only patch caveats
stop if design routes directly to measured controller comparison
stop if design claims reset-valid redesigned scenario pack
fallback_plan: route to reset-validation implementation if schema is sufficient
pivot to patch-resolution repair design if metadata caveats cannot be represented
stop for user review if no bounded reset-validation protocol is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2351 routes dual-axis calibration branch to candidate pack reset-validation design

admission_evidence: M2351 accepts branch continuation to reset-validation design
allowed_updates: M2352 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: pack list and scenario count expectations are specified
output artifacts and summary fields are specified
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2352 designs task-quality reset validation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2352; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Reset-validation design must not be interpreted as driver, controller, or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset-valid scenario pack, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares a bounded reset-validation protocol after branch synthesis instead of extending artifact-only local search
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can produce the first reset-validity evidence for dual-axis candidate packs in a later implementation milestone
must_synthesize_if: M2352 cannot bound the reset-validation protocol
M2352 routes directly to controller comparison
the reset-validation branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded reset-validation design can test the five M2350 candidate config packs while preserving metadata-only caveat reporting and claim boundaries.
success_criteria: pack list and scenario count expectations are specified
a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2352 starts training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2352 ranks support policies or controller families
M2352 overwrites the active scenario config
M2352 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2352 claims scenario redesign executed or reset-valid redesigned scenario pack
M2352 routes directly to controller comparison

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design from M2351 synthesis and M2350 config-pack artifacts

decision_rule: M2352 passes if it designs a bounded non-ranking reset-validation implementation route without execution or claims.
